commits.summary: v9 extension_data.s carries v10's typed form. v9 and v10 are byte-identical over 0xED0008-0xEE0010. The 951 C-compiled sndparam records are written as sndparam_descriptor macro lines. Markers 8,244 -> 28. Adds lane_line_map.py, lane_file_figures.py and port_extension_data_from_v10.py.

TOSHI object tables that InitializeToshi registers (v10, v9). Toshi_ApFunction (42), Function (28) and MainFunction (20) tables go from .byte rows to .long <routine>; each entry is checked against its parallel name table. Count words become .short; ResEvent/ResMethod tables are reframed; Toshi_Class_Table gets its 24-byte record header; the chord-table tail is fixed. `.long Naka_PresentationRootState` becomes `.short 319, 239`. extension_init.s is fully symbolic, with the 60 viewable/resname tables as named offsets from NakaInst_ExtDevice_Screens.

v7 port. v7 has the same layout and differs only in values: 360 pointers resolve to the same v7 symbol names, 15 .byte rows take v7 values. Markers 8,066 -> 27; 3,902 B of romslices retired. v7's 900-line long-form InitializeToshi is replaced by the macro form, byte-identical. One provably false comment dropped (the swapped Naka_PresentationRootState address).

The last 87 data-as-code lines in v10 are retired (markers now 0 in all versions). 11 *_EventOffsets tables, FswAssign codes/names, and 38 NAKA widget records (Toshi_Viewable_NORMAL elements 24-62) via a new naka_node macro. Error-dialog LABEL records typed. 16 coordinate pairs that had been written as .long pointers are removed. Four false 'Widget N / screen group' comments corrected.

SoundProgram_DispatchTable evidence header (256 entries, reader FileIO_OperationDispatch). The +0x400 / +0x800 / +0x880 sub-tables typed with their readers. 934 record equates rewritten as .set, which removes the census artefact that graded 394 B as CODE.

The 20 records not compiled from C become sndparam_descriptor lines, and the macro now lives in v10. 11 value maps and their 10-byte descriptors typed (read via the pointer table at 0xEE0154 using aux_index). Adds ext_retype_span.py and the vmaps check.

Seven language-indexed string tables (EN DE FR ES IT ID), each returned by a *LngCheck ApFunction, are reframed and named LngTable_*. Adds 18 string labels. Findings: Italian was never translated, and three tables have only EN and DE.
ENCODER_LUT_* curves (previously .ascii ramps) and eight DispatchBitmaskHandlers {mask, handler} lists typed. 32 handlers symbolic, 6 numeric. The port tool now also rewrites all-hex .long rows.

28 sound-effect presets (10 reverb x24 B, 9 EQ x24 B, 9 combined x48 B) and ReverbPreset_Table / EQPreset_Table / CombinedPreset_Table typed, with the Load/FindMatch readers cited. Adds the presets check.

The seven SoundProgram +0x890..+0x907 sub-tables typed with readers. DataSlot_HeaderTemplate. SndParamRam_DefaultImage (1,026 B default image of RAM 0xF9A0-0xFDA1). Three sndparam copy templates. The 558 B that follow are honestly marked 'no reader found', with the search forms listed.

The 28 Toshi class instance-variable name tables (0xED20C6-0xED27E3) are framed and attributed to their classes. The existing labels, which mostly name the wrong class, are documented; 21 new ClassVar_* labels.

Six more event-offset tables (FSWAssGridCheck, FswAsIniFunc, DispTimeSetGridCheck, AcPmExpFilterGridBoxProc, PmExpFilterGridCheck, AcDispTimeSetGridBoxProc). PmExpFilter key lists: 18 u32 values, all of them sndparam record keys. SelectRect_Table, where two more fake pointers were removed.
SoundCheck_Text and the WallHome/Menu/OthEdit text blocks, each with a reader list per positional name. AudioCtl_SmallTables after the LED-row list, readers cited.

Findings that concern other lanes' files:
1. nakabig (naka_types.h and control_menu_screens.s header): the four words after the header of NAKA records (types 0x2B, 0x35, 0x3C, 0x69) are:
   - +4 parent;
   - +6 FIRST CHILD;
   - +8 NEXT sibling;
   - +10 PREVIOUS sibling.
   These are element indices of the viewable table the record is registered in; +0x0E..+0x14 is a screen rectangle x1,y1,x2,y2 inside the parent's. Proven by `ext_lane_checks.py widgets`/`test1`. naka_types.h names them prev_sibling/self_idx/next_sibling, and the "Screen group / Widget index" reading is wrong.
2. Coordinate pairs still written as pointers elsewhere:
   - factory_test/fd_test_data.s:117 `.long Naka_PresentationRootState` ({319,239});
   - ui_widgets/widget_dispatch.s:7859 `.long WidgetName_PtrBlock_O`;
   - NAKA_ADDR(ExtData_ChordTypeTable_Top) in naka_perf_style.c ptr_061a/ptr_071e and naka_extension_device.c ptr_0a7c/ptr_0bd0 (value {8,237}).
   A test: a pointer v7 would have relocated but did not is not a pointer.
3. sndparam_types.h: two accessors in sndparam_routines.s index the 11-entry value-map descriptor table at 0xEE0154 with +0x0B aux_index, not the record table at 0xEE0198. The descriptor layout is {u32 map, u16 count, u8, unaligned u16 +7, 0xFF}.

Then delete the .set lines.

   - Symbolize the code literals: MainChordPre `ld xwa,0xed1c96/0xed1c9a` -> ChordStr_On/ChordStr_Blank, and `lda xbc,(0xecff6a:24)` -> the chord pointer table.

   - Delete the dead `.set ToshiParam_Entry_01..27`.
5. Joint rename with the naka lane: ChordTypeStr_* (sharp/flat swapped; "~9e" is sharp, "~a0" is flat), NakaDesc_*/NakaInst_* (one class off), and the class-variable table labels. The class for each is recorded in the first-entry comments.
6. Instrument bugs:
   - data_range_census.py treats a `NAME = expr` line as an instruction that owns the next line's bytes (other files may still carry it).
   - Its DocIndex keeps a comment run open across blank lines, so a file header leaks into the first object and can flip it to "admits".
   - assert_comments_preserved.py misreads text after ';' inside `.ascii` literals containing an escaped quote as a comment.
7. Misframed code seen near the readers (audio lane): sndparam_routines.s and audio_control_engine.s have `.byte 0xc3 / reti / .byte 0xe4, 0xe0`, which is ld_sril3 decoded one byte out. ui_mode_handlers.s near FSWAssGrid has `.byte 0x94 / push xsp` and `calr 2206`.
8. Open research: what reads 0xEDB7FE-0xEDBA2B; how the factory sound-check screen (SoundCheck_Text) is entered; the meaning of the value-map descriptor +6 byte and the +0x890 record's +3..+5.
